image:image.image:caption: Vehicle size, staging, and maneuvering space must be reviewed together. Confirm the fleet and swept path against a surveyed site plan.

image:image.image:caption: Industrial properties in Elk Grove Village, Illinois. Model each asset’s cash flow and test lease, capital, financing and exit assumptions.
